title: Spore Dispersal in Fungi—Airborne Spores and Allergy

questions.q: Kendrick says the main reason for fungal success he underplayed earlier is:
c: Their ability to produce and disperse vast numbers of specialized spores

questions.q: Which three phyla are basically aquatic, with flagellate spores?
How do *Pythium* and *Phytophthora* zoospores find host roots?
c: By swimming up gradients of sugars and other chemicals leaking from roots

questions.q: Some chytrids attacking nematodes swim toward substances from the worms' bodily orifices. This is called chemotaxis.
Which two new structures evolved in oomycetes that parasitize aerial plant parts?

questions.q: *Rhizopus stolonifer* sporangia release spores that are:

questions.q: Why does puffing carry spores farther than individual discharge?
c: The many simultaneous jets create a general air movement above the hymenium

questions.q: In ostiolate ascomata, asci must take turns firing because each must:

c: Truffles emit a chemical that sows otherwise encounter from rutting boars

questions.q: In *Coprinus comatus*, why does the gill tissue autolyze from the bottom edge upward?
